sp_widget.description: The tenant management widget. Displays all configured tenants in a table with active/inactive status. For a single tenant, active is auto-locked to true. For multiple tenants, admins can toggle the active status via dropdowns and bulk-save changes. Includes Refresh Tenants and Save buttons in the header.
